title: Eben Alexander near-death experience

tellings.quote: He has a very interesting scientific outlook of his near-death. And that was like this, like overarching, like, loving energy.

plain: In 2008, a man named Eben Alexander says he had a near-death experience in which he felt an overarching, loving energy. He told the story in his book Proof of Heaven. David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who went public about secret government UFO programmes, brings it up with Michels and praises Alexander's "very interesting scientific outlook" on what happened to him.
